faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by AIC STPINEXT Initiatives (STPINEXT) for KALPATARU CoE at STPI-Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Incubation Manager for KALPATARU CoE, STPI-Visakhapatnam under advertisement number 01/2026/STPINEXT/KALPATARU CoE.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Incubation Manager post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a graduate from a recognized university. A Post Graduation in Management is desirable along with relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is below 35 years, with age relaxation permissible for deserving candidates as per organizational norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging from Rs.50,000 to Rs.75,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 20 days from the date of publication of the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through online mode by visiting the official websites provided by STPINEXT.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening of applications by a Screening Committee, followed by a personal interview before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification and website through the Important Links section provided in this recruitment article.
